cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Lend me your good tennis racket. I'd like my talent to have a fair surface. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll thank the strings. The strokes remain mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use your own racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?

mechanism: A negotiates a tennis-racket loan with return and credit concessions while protecting the claim that winning strokes are A own.
confusable: Unlike simply borrowing useful equipment, A restricts acknowledgment so success remains personal.
comparison: Public credit to equipment and prompt return differ from privately exchanged baking temperature.
seedUse: D193-a racket and strings; S02-a bargains for B cooperation instead of ending on an abstract defeat quip.
